title: Zeros of the executable power sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $ℓ$ be a positive natural number. Choose a monic binary polynomial of degree $ℓ$ that is irreducible, and let $γ$ be a nonzero binary vector of length $n$. Using the chosen polynomial to perform multiplication modulo it, form the sum of $γ_i r^{i+1}$ over $0\le i<n$ for each binary vector $r$ of length $ℓ$. At most $n$ such vectors make this sum zero.
